title: [Lean] Packed Clifford representation bridge and a source-bound CK child
body:
This chunk proves the little-endian packed/vector Clifford bridge and applies it to the historical CK-HPE catalog ordinal 0: directed key 0 → 2, rank 1, ordered descriptors [] → [459], at commit 5996f9043c27bafa90b23e1c937de92a738f1a76.

The final theorem is an equality for every complex payload. It preserves inverse-row reads, strict-upper quadratic phases, XOR offsets, stored global phase and the exact Gaussian coefficients (1+i)/2 and (1−i)/2. The chronological recipe is right monomial → Gaussian → left monomial.

Explicit author-checked historical κ: 16127213726553 / 10000000000000000 = 0.0016127213726553. This value is the pinned conditional construction context, checked against selected-result.json and its assembly receipt. These local Lean results do not derive κ or the full integer-multiplication bound, and do not claim adoption of a newer selected construction.

The coherent closure has 20 sources: seven exact retained PR581 dependencies and thirteen included roots, with 125 axiom probes and 2,663 pinned runtime source/object pairs. The unchanged PR593 Clifford source is credited to Jeremy Kothe and Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), in omp; all inherited source attribution is retained. Exact sources, prior accepted identities and the package's measured reproduction are recorded separately in MANIFEST.json, ACCEPTED_CHECKS.json and REPRODUCTION.json.

Event-stream, pre-A, physical-executor, full-work, residual/endpoint and complete-catalog obligations remain explicit. PR593 Exact helpers and heavy concrete certificates are outside this chunk.

The fresh compilers used 92.850112286 seconds in total, with 0.006096456 seconds of FIFO waiting and a peak virtual-memory sample of 3,647,012,864 bytes. Each root stayed within the existing review limits. These measurements reproduce the stated historical local proof scope.

Publication candidate: `5bbf44624fc3902dc7c53a2f06df90ee73928532`, based on `f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631`, with exactly 31 new package files. The candidate also preserves the recorded standalone Python 3.13 `verify-research` evidence within its explicitly reviewed closure: 211 identical declared input bodies, one exactly inverted target-preserving Makefile difference, 28 unchanged actual command/output records, 72 matching current import origins and 204 checked provenance links.
